thread:
laura_sales: Customer (health-tech) POC: need concise connectivity options for NetOps. Requirements: preserve client IP for audit, support TLS-inspect middlebox, SNI rewrite implications, and an allowlist they can drop into their firewall. Also they want cost delta PrivateLink vs peering for 2-week POC.

andy_netops: Short summary: peering preserves src IP natively; PrivateLink is quicker to provision but typically NATs source unless you run a proxy/NLB in their VPC. PrivateLink has per-endpoint hourly + per-GB processing.

jun_infra: Two recommended POC patterns: 1) PrivateLink + internal NLB + reverse proxy -> preserves identity via X-Forwarded-For; 2) Cross-account VPC peering -> preserves source IP and is simplest for src-based ACLs.

maya_sales_eng: They asked for a copy/paste firewall snippet for PrivateLink.

andy_netops: Provide this (replace placeholders):
```
# OUTBOUND allowlist for Redwood PrivateLink POC
# replace <REDFW_EIP_1> with EIP we provide
allow tcp from 10.0.0.0/16 to <REDFW_EIP_1> 443
allow udp from 10.0.0.0/16 to <REDFW_EIP_1> 123
```

security_ops: Security note: if they perform TLS inspection that rewrites SNI or terminates mTLS, cert pinning / mTLS validation can break. Mitigations: terminate mTLS at customer edge and use app-level auth to us, or request Dedicated deployment / mutual TLS tunnel.

laura_sales: Can we give a 1-paragraph POC cost guide?

andy_netops: Quick estimate: PrivateLink ~ small hourly endpoint fee (~$0.02-0.05/hr) + data processing ($0.01-0.05/GB). For ~100GB over 2 weeks expect ~$10-100 + endpoint hours. Peering has no endpoint-hour fee but transfer costs may apply; for light POC similar ballpark. Dedicated requires capacity reservation (monthly).

jun_infra: Ops checklist to include in email: request endpoint EIPs 24-48h before cutover; confirm whether they accept X-Forwarded-For vs need src-IP; confirm TLS-inspect behavior (do they rewrite SNI?).

laura_sales: Perfect. I'll send this plus the snippet and ask for their NetOps contact. Thanks!
